description: Reasons a component may have no behavior contract (spec/behavior-contract.md#exemptions). A component is exempt only because it takes no interaction; `behavior-exemptions.json` pairs each exempt component with one of these reasons.

values.label: Static text
values.description: Text that is read, not operated: a heading, a body paragraph, a label or help text. Nothing to press, focus or change.

values.label: Static display
values.description: Presents information or an image and takes no input: a badge, a status light, an avatar, a divider. If a platform makes one pressable or selectable, it needs a contract instead.

values.label: Container
values.description: Lays out, groups or wraps other components, or is a sub-part of one, and has no interaction of its own: a card, a panel, a form item. Any behavior belongs to the components inside it, or to the parent component's contract.

values.label: Decorative
values.description: Visual embellishment with no meaning for assistive technology: a checkerboard behind a transparent color, a pulsing marker. The component it decorates carries any behavior.
